KAS Properties

KAS Properties

Ɛka Al Sheikh Investment Group ho

KAS Properties wɔ UAE na ɛyɛ tenabea ne aguadi adan ho adwuma. Yɛn dwumadi ne adan sohwɛ, asase tɔn ne ntamgyina wɔ tɔ, tɔn ne gye-som ho.

Yɛn adwuma ka asase ne adan ahiade ne hokwan bom wɔ Dubai, Middle East ne Africa. Ne yɛn adwumayɛfo mmɔ wo agyapade, ne beae ne wo aguadi ahiade ho nkɔmmɔ.
